Welcome to the Jargon File

   This document (the Jargon File) is in the public domain, to be freely
   used, shared, and modified.

Chapter 1. Hacker Slang and Hacker Culture

   This  document  is  a  collection  of  slang terms used by various
   subcultures of computer hackers.

The Jargon Lexicon

Glossary

   A

        hack

A

   hack
   kluge

:hack:

   1.  n.  Originally, a quick job that produces what is needed, but not
   well. See {kluge}, {hacker} and {nowhere}.

:kluge: /klooj/

   [from the German `klug', clever]

   1. n. A Rube Goldberg device. Often involves {hack}.

        if (x) { y(); }
        else z();

H

   hacker

:hacker: n.

   A person who enjoys exploring the details of programmable systems.
   Café culture.

Appendix A. Hacker Folklore

The Story of Mel

   Mel wrote code for the RPC-4000.
